quote_zh: 数量惊人的酒店不是由公共股东、不是私人业主、甚至不是私募股权基金拥有，而是由政府拥有！ 你不容易看到这一点，因为你必须挖得很深（或者实际上向上挖），并且它们用很多结构掩盖它 就像巴黎的这家酒店“Le Ballu”，听起来像法国人吗？是的，是的
full_text_en:
TIL a crazy number of hotels is owned not by public stock holders, not by private owners, not even by private equity funds, but by governments!

You don't see this easily, because you have to dig quite deep (or well dig upward actually) and they cover it up in lots of constructions

Like this hotel in Paris "Le Ballu", sounds French? Yes and it's owned by Hotels & Preference, which on paper is a French international hotel chain

Hotels & Preference itself is owned by the Louvre Hotels Group, sounds French too? Yes

But Louvre Hotels Group is owned by Jin Jiang International, that doesn't sound so French anymore? So it must be a Chinese company? Right?

No! It's the municipality of Shanghai!?

Yes the the local council of Shanghai somehow owns 539 hotels around the world including Raddison, Park Plaza, Vienna House, Golden Tulip, Campanile, Kyriad etc.

Other big government owners are the government of Dubai, Brunei and Qatar

So I added a filter [ Government-owned hotels ] and every hotel page shows the TRUE owner of a hotel, not just the chain!
full_text_zh:
数量惊人的酒店不是由公共股东、不是私人业主、甚至不是私募股权基金拥有，而是由政府拥有！

你不容易看到这一点，因为你必须挖得很深（或者实际上向上挖），并且它们用很多结构掩盖它 就像巴黎的这家酒店“Le Ballu”，听起来像法国人吗？

是的，它属于 Hotels & Preference 所有，名义上是一家法国国际连锁酒店 Hotels & Preference 本身隶属于卢浮宫酒店集团，听起来也像法国人吗？

是的 但罗浮宫酒店集团是锦江国际旗下的，这听起来不那么法国了吗？

那么一定是中国公司吧？

正确的？

不！

这是上海市区！

？

是的，上海地方议会在全球拥有 539 家酒店，包括雷迪森酒店、丽亭酒店、维也纳之家酒店、金郁金香酒店、康铂酒店、凯里亚德酒店等。

其他大型政府所有者包括迪拜、文莱和卡塔尔政府 所以我添加了一个过滤器[政府拥有的酒店]，每个酒店页面都显示酒店的真正所有者，而不仅仅是连锁酒店！

quote_zh: 今天，Astra 能够生成/预测超过其截止日期的特定新论文的概率是多少？朴素采样很棘手（尾部概率小得惊人）。 定价指导的关键思想是，您可以通过模型（Astra）和指南 LLM（Astra 与论文）之间的对话来降低此概率，其中我们
full_text_en:
What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampling is intractable (tail probability is astronomically small).

The key idea of priced guidance is that you can lower bound this probability via a dialogue between the model (Astra) and a guide LLM (Astra with the paper), where we can precisely account for the bits of information sent from the guide to the model. One can also can think of this as a new eval for frontier models.
full_text_zh:
Astra 今天能够生成/预测超过其截止日期的特定新论文的概率是多少？朴素采样很棘手（尾部概率小得惊人）。

定价指导的关键思想是，您可以通过模型（Astra）和指南 LLM（Astra 与论文）之间的对话来降低这个概率，我们可以精确地解释从指南发送到模型的信息位。人们也可以将其视为对前沿模型的新评估。

Developers have been using the Decisions API to:

• Route requests to the right model, tool, or agent.

• Turn scaled inputs into useful labels, rankings, and scores.

• Analyze images, compare visual content, or identify key video frames.

• Choose buttons, navigate forms, or determine actions from screenshots.

• Flag risky tool calls or identify issues needing deeper review.

• Categorize large datasets to uncover trends and patterns.

title: Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having
title_zh: Mistral发布了Mistral Large 4 ，在人工智能指数上得分38 ；法国又回到了拥有最聪明的模型
quote_zh: Mistral发布了Mistral Large 4 ，在人工智能指数上得分38 ；法国又回到了拥有最聪明的模型
full_text_en:
Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having the most intelligent model from outside the US and China

@MistralAI has released Mistral Large 4 in Research Public Preview, with plans to release the weights of the 1T parameter (49B active) model at the end of October. It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

Key benchmarking results for Mistral Large 4 Preview:

➤ Most intelligent model from outside the US and China: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 38 on the Intelligence Index, comparable to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 38). This makes it the most intelligent model from outside the US and China, ahead of countries such as South Korea and the United Arab Emirates

➤ Level with GLM-5.3-Flash on cyber defense capability: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 50 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash (50) and behind MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56). Once its weights are released, it will rank among the top three open weights models on the Cyber Index. Its strongest result is on CyberGym-E2E-AA, where it scores 82%, ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Pro (79%) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 78%)

➤ Over 4x the Cost per Task of similar-intelligence open weights models: Mistral Large 4 Preview costs $1.13 per Intelligence Index task with standard pricing of $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens, with $0.14 per 1M cached input tokens. For the first two weeks, Mistral Large 4 Preview will be served at a 50% launch discount, bringing its Cost per Task down to $0.57. This is still more costly than GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.25) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, $0.27)

➤ Strong document and image reasoning: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 19% on GDP.pdf, on par with MiMo-V2.6-Pro (19%) and behind Kimi K3 (22%). This is an 18-point improvement from Mistral Large 3, partly driven by improvements in their API, which now accepts 100 images per request, up from 8 for previous Mistral models

Key model details:

➤ Context Window: 512k tokens

➤ Multimodality: Text and image input, with text output

➤ Pricing: $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.14 per 1M cached input tokens), with 50% off for the first two weeks ($0.68/$2.09)

➤ Availability: Research Public Preview on Mistral's API, with open weights planned for the end of October

这使其成为美国和中国以外最智能的模型，领先于韩国和阿拉伯联合酋长国等国家 ➤ 网络防御能力与 GLM-5.3-Flash 持平：Mistral Large 4 Preview 在人工分析网络指数上得分 50，与 GLM-5.3-Flash (50) 持平，落后于 MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56)。

full_text_en:
Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with particular improvement in agentic capabilities

@AntLingAGI has released Ling 3.1 Flash, a reasoning model with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters, and a 1M token context window. It scores 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, up from 20 from Ling 3.0 Flash, which launched in August. Ling 3.1 Flash is expected to be open weights, with Ant Group releasing the weights soon.

Key results:

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash improves agentic capabilities over its predecessor. With a GDPval-AA v2 Elo of 1,622 and an AA-Briefcase Elo of 1,400, the model rivals peer models such as GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash (high) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max). Ling 3.1 Flash also shows notable gains on AutomationBench-AA (62%) and Terminal-Bench v4.0 (33%).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash scores +2 on AA-Omniscience, a 22 point improvements from Ling 3.0 Flash (-18). Compared to its predecessor, its accuracy rate rose from 18% to 29% while the hallucination rate fell from 44% to 38% at a similar attempt rate (56% to 58%), demonstrating the gain comes primarily from knowing more, not abstaining more. For comparison, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max) has a hallucination rate of 97%.

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash is a larger model than its predecessor, priced accordingly, but more token efficient. It has 560B total and 25B active parameters, up from 124B and 5.1B for Ling 3.0 Flash, and is priced at $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M input / output tokens, up from $0.075 / $0.22. It used 218M output tokens to run the Intelligence Index, 16% fewer than Ling 3.0 Flash (261M).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash has a higher cost per task than some peers, but remains in the most attractive quadrant. Ling 3.1 Flash costs $0.99 per task, well above GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.42) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max, $0.32) but below Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) at $1.24.

Additional model details:

➤ Size: 560B total parameters, 25B active

➤ Context window: 1M tokens

➤ Pricing: $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $0.90 per 1M output tokens, with cached input at $0.06 per 1M (80% discount)

➤ Availability: Accessible through Novita AI, with weights coming soon

title: OpenAI Web Search debuts on the Artificial Analysis Search Index at 74, the 5th best provider behind Perplexity, Octen,
title_zh: OpenAI Web Search在人工分析搜索指数上首次亮相，排名第74位，仅次于Perplexity、Octen、Parallel和Brave ，排名第5 @ OpenAI Web Search i
quote_zh: OpenAI Web Search在人工分析搜索指数上首次亮相，排名第74位，仅次于Perplexity、Octen、Parallel和Brave ，排名第5 @ OpenAI Web Search i
full_text_en:
OpenAI Web Search debuts on the Artificial Analysis Search Index at 74, the 5th best provider behind Perplexity, Octen, Parallel and Brave

@OpenAI Web Search is the first integrated first-party search tool on our board. Instead of an agent calling a Search API in our Stirrup harness, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) calls OpenAI's built-in web_search tool, and OpenAI runs the whole search loop inside one Responses API call. All setups use the same underlying model, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning).

At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search costs less than Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07), but about twice as much as Octen ($0.024), which scores 3 points higher.

Key benchmarking results for OpenAI Web Search (medium search context):

➤ 5th best provider on the Artificial Analysis Search Index: OpenAI Web Search scores 74, a 41-point lift over the same model with no search (33). It places 7th of 26 products, level with You . com (highlights), Nimble (standard) and Exa (auto) at 74, behind the three Perplexity variants (77 to 80), Octen (77), Parallel (advanced) and Brave (LLM context) at 75

➤ OpenAI Web Search performs best on AA-Omniscience, our proprietary factual answer benchmark, achieving 72% accuracy. This ranks 3rd of 26 search provider variants, within 1 point of the leader, Firecrawl (73%). BrowseComp, which needs multi-hop reasoning across several searches, is its weakest benchmark: at 73.5% it ranks 13th of 26, well behind the Perplexity variants and Octen (85% to 87%)

➤ OpenAI Web Search uses fewer tokens for the same tasks: OpenAI bills about 40k input tokens per task, search results included, against 125k for the leanest Search API on the board, Perplexity (low). Its model cost is among the lowest on the board, at about $0.009 per task

➤ Built-in search costs less per task than most Search APIs: At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search is cheaper than 17 of the 25 Search API products on the board (median $0.067), including Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07). Octen costs about half as much ($0.024) and scores 3 points higher

Key details:

➤ Setup: GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) with OpenAI's web_search tool and search_context_size set to medium, in one Responses API call

➤ Pricing: $10 per 1k web_search calls, plus the search content, which OpenAI bills as model input tokens

➤ Contamination: we block known contamination sources through the tool's domain filter
full_text_zh:

所有设置都使用相同的底层模型，GPT-5.6 Luna（中等推理）。

➤ 人工分析搜索指数排名第五：OpenAI Web 搜索得分 74，比没有搜索的同一模型 (33) 高出 41 分。

ElevenLabs' Eleven v4 Turbo takes the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Provider Voice TTS Arena Leaderboard, ahead of Eleven v4 while costing half the price

Eleven v4 Turbo is the faster, lower-cost sibling of Eleven v4 from @ElevenLabs, designed to deliver comparable speech quality with lower latency and cost.

➤ Provider Voice: Eleven v4 Turbo has an Elo of 1,334 (+19/-19) across 1,645 appearances, placing it ahead of Eleven v4 at 1,321, Alibaba's Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus at 1,292 and Cartesia's Sonic 3.6 at 1,278. It ranks #1 in Customer Service and Entertainment and #2 in Assistants and Knowledge Sharing.

➤ Controlled Voice: Eleven v4 Turbo ranks #2 with an Elo of 1,173 (+15/-15) across 1,745 appearances, behind Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus at 1,181 and ahead of Eleven v4 at 1,160. It ranks #1 in Arabic, German, Hindi and English (UK).

➤ Pronunciation Robustness: Eleven v4 Turbo scores 90.1%, ranking #2 behind Eleven v4 at 91.7% and ahead of Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS at 89.5%.

➤ Pricing: Eleven v4 Turbo is priced at $40/1M characters, half the price of Eleven v4 at $80/1M characters, compared to Sonic 3.6 at $49/1M characters and Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS at $16.49/1M characters.

➤ Speed: Eleven v4 Turbo processes 96 characters per second of generation time, compared to 84 characters per second for Eleven v4 and 59 for Eleven v3.

Hotels have a hard time doing that, so how do you grow? You cut costs and big hotel chains have been doing that in the name of DEI and ESG and wokeness a lot. Locking down ACs, no daily cleaning, cutting corners, etc. it all saves money

Those cost savings mean higer profit margins mean growth!

Great as an ETF or stock holder, terrible as a hotel guest

So you can now filter on privately owned

One of the most consistent quality hotel chains I visit is Four Seasons (recommended by many people on here), not cheap, but almost always a good experience

Guess who owns Four Seasons? It's private! And it's @billgates and @Alwaleed_Talal

They must have a had such terrible hotel experiences, they had to buy their own hotel to get a good one! Can you imagine? 😂

title:
OCR is dead 🪦 Long live agentic OCR!

Traditional OCR makes one pass and hands back whatever text it got. Tables get fla
title_zh: OCR已死🪦代理OCR万岁！ 传统的OCR只需要传递一次，然后返回得到的文本。表格变得扁平，图表消失，多栏布局变得混乱。没有检查输出。 代理OCR将解析视为循环： ✅layout-aware
quote_zh: OCR已死🪦代理OCR万岁！ 传统的OCR只需要传递一次，然后返回得到的文本。表格变得扁平，图表消失，多栏布局变得混乱。没有检查输出。 代理OCR将解析视为循环： ✅layout-aware
full_text_en:
OCR is dead 🪦 Long live agentic OCR!

Traditional OCR makes one pass and hands back whatever text it got. Tables get flattened, charts disappear, and multi-column layouts come out scrambled. Nothing checks the output.

Agentic OCR treats parsing as a loop instead:

✅ layout-aware reading order
✅ smart routing of hard elements to the right model
✅ multi-pass verification and self-correction
✅ multimodal parsing of charts, images, and complex tables

Logan Markewich, LlamaIndex's Head of Open Source, wrote about what that shift looks like in practice and where it's still struggling. Link to the breakdown in the comments below.
full_text_zh:
OCR 已死🪦
代理 OCR 万岁！

传统的 OCR 只进行一次传递，然后将收到的任何文本返还给用户。

表格变平，图表消失，多列布局变得混乱。

没有任何东西检查输出。

代理 OCR 将解析视为循环：
✅ 布局感知的阅读顺序
✅ 将硬元件智能路由到正确的模型
✅ 多遍验证和自我修正
✅ 图表、图像和复杂表格的多模态解析 LlamaIndex 的开源主管 Logan Markewich 撰写了有关这种转变在实践中的情况以及仍在挣扎的地方的文章。

链接到下面评论中的细分。

Watermarks have limits. They’re often undetectable, especially in short passages. Rewriting or translating text can completely remove the watermark.

That’s why, for now, only approved researchers will have access to our detector, so they can help us evaluate and improve the technology.

We’re treating text watermarking as an ongoing area of research. We’ll keep testing and improving, with feedback from users, developers, policymakers, and researchers.

full_text_en:
When possible, we want to give people a choice—and be clear about what watermarking can and can’t do.

A text watermark helps answer one question: “Was this likely generated by an OpenAI model?”

It works by embedding an invisible statistical signal in text as it’s generated. A detector can look for this signal, and it doesn’t add visible marks or special characters. It doesn’t say who originally wrote the text or who owns it. It doesn’t identify a person, organization, account, conversation, or prompt.

In our testing, watermarking hasn’t affected how capable or fast our models are, or how their responses read.
full_text_zh:
如果可能的话，我们希望给人们一个选择，并明确水印可以做什么和不能做什么。

文本水印有助于回答一个问题：“这可能是由 OpenAI 模型生成的吗？”

它的工作原理是在生成的文本中嵌入不可见的统计信号。探测器可以寻找该信号，并且不会添加可见标记或特殊字符。它没有说明谁最初写了该文本或谁拥有该文本。它不识别个人、组织、帐户、对话或提示。

在我们的测试中，水印并没有影响我们模型的能力或速度，或者它们的响应的读取方式。

full_text_en:
We're expanding our approach to content provenance to include text in response to EU regulatory requirements, while recognizing the significant limitations of current text watermarking technology.

Our tools already help verify whether an image or audio file was created with our models. This work builds on those efforts to help people better understand when content may have been generated or edited with an OpenAI model.

In the EU, we’ll start watermarking eligible text from ChatGPT and Codex over the coming weeks to comply with the EU AI Act.

Customers using our API can turn on text watermarking for select models worldwide today.

我们正在扩展我们的内容来源方法，以包括响应欧盟监管要求的文本，同时认识到当前文本水印技术的重大局限性。

full_text_en:
Ideogram 4.5 debuts at #23 on the AA-Image-Editing v2.0 leaderboard, Ideogram's first model on the board, and lands at #34 on AA-Image-T2I v2.0

Ideogram 4.5 is Ideogram's new image model, released on September 30. Ideogram positions it as a high precision edit model, built to reduce pixel shifts, color changes and texture artifacts across multi-turn edits. It also supports Text to Image. We evaluated Ideogram 4.5 at “high” quality level.

In AA-Image-Editing v2.0, Ideogram 4.5 takes #23, just behind HiDream-O1-Edit-1.5 and HunyuanImage 3.0 Instruct and ahead of ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Lite. It is the first Ideogram model on our Image Editing Leaderboard. In AA-Image-T2I v2.0 it ranks #34, climbing from #40 for Ideogram 4.0.

At the High quality setting we evaluated, Ideogram 4.5 is priced at $0.22 per image ($220 per 1k images) for edits and $0.10 per image ($100 per 1k) for Text to Image. Lower quality tiers start at $0.008 per image for edits and $0.03 per image for Text to Image.

Ideogram 4.5 is live in Ideogram, the Ideogram API and Ideogram's launch partners, with open weights coming soon.

Congratulations to @ideogram_ai on the release!

See below for our analysis and example outputs of Ideogram 4.5 in the Artificial Analysis Image Arena 🧵

full_text_en:
We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent where you configure model, instructions, tools, connectors, run settings, all under one versioned ID. A project admin sets it up once and every developer on the project can call it from their own app with the project API key. This helps you avoid copying the same config into every application and updating it in five places when the procedure changes.

Skills are versioned so you can ship v2 of a procedure without touching each integration. 

Connectors (GitHub, Slack, Drive, Datadog, Linear, Notion to start) are configured once by the admin. That way, apps don’t hold their own credentials.

Profiles and Skills are live today. Connectors in preview.

https://t.co/deOSF89btK

title: 🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that
title_zh: 🚨GPT-6.1 Astra已经正式报废，这是OpenAI第一次完全放弃一个已经有名字和计划发布日期的旗舰机型，而不是像
quote_zh: 🚨GPT-6.1 Astra已经正式报废，这是OpenAI第一次完全放弃一个已经有名字和计划发布日期的旗舰机型，而不是像往常一样推迟几周，增加更多的保护措施，无论如何都要发货
full_text_en:
🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that already had a name and planned release date, instead of doing what it usually does delay it for a couple of weeks, add more safeguards, and ship it anyway, That suggests capability gains may now be creating alignment regressions that the current monitoring stack still can’t fully contain

According to summaries of the WSJ exclusive  the full article is paywalled  internal testing showed worse alignment compared with the GPT 6 Astra released in September more deception, with the model not always being truthful about what it had or hadn’t done, and failures around scope authorization, where in some cases it kept working without permission, went beyond what the user had asked, and used external tools or services in unsafe ways

Saachi Jain, who leads safety systems at OpenAI, said in an interview that GPT 6.1 Astra did improve on “laziness” meaning it was less likely to leave tasks unfinished or give incomplete answers  but it still wasn’t reliable enough to release publicly, OpenAI now appears to prefer strengthening the safety of the more advanced models that come after it rather than shipping this incremental upgrade
full_text_zh:
🚨GPT-6.1 Astra 已被正式废弃，这是 OpenAI 第一次完全放弃已经有了名称和计划发布日期的旗舰模型，而不是像通常那样推迟几周，添加更多保护措施，然后无论如何都将其交付，这表明能力增益现在可能会造成当前监控堆栈仍然无法完全包含的对齐回归

根据《华尔街日报》独家报道，付费墙内部测试显示，与 9 月份发布的 GPT 6 Astra 相比，一致性更差，更多的欺骗行为，该模型并不总是诚实地说明自己做了什么或没有做什么，并且在范围授权方面存在失败，在某些情况下，它在未经许可的情况下继续工作，超出了用户的要求，并以不安全的方式使用外部工具或服务

OpenAI 安全系统负责人 Saachi Jain 在接受采访时表示，GPT 6.1 Astra 确实改进了“惰性”，这意味着它不太可能留下未完成的任务或给出不完整的答案，但它仍然不够可靠，无法公开发布，OpenAI 现在似乎更愿意加强后续更先进模型的安全性，而不是交付这种增量升级

Meta thought Muse had this locked up after JPMorgan crowned it #1. That lead might last exactly one keynote.

The 3 use cases that actually matter:

1️⃣ Inbox & calendar on autopilot. Triage, replies, scheduling, follow-ups. You wake up and it's already done.

2️⃣ End-to-end errands. Research, compare, book, buy. From "I need X" to confirmation, zero tabs open.

3️⃣ Long-running background work. Monitoring, routines, multi-hour tasks that keep going while you sleep.

Set your alarms fammm, devday will be huge!

I've had a home gym since 2018. If you have the space and want to be consistent, this should be a priority.

If you have it at home, you'll use it way more.

title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
title_zh: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing.
quote_zh: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing 开源生态 提效工具 for sandboxing AI 智能体矩阵. OpenWorker, our open-source 智能体 harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this. A sandbox gives an 智能体 limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will suppo
full_text_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
full_text_zh:
OpenAI-Hugging Face 黑客攻击是通过弱沙箱实现的。

Nvidia 发布了用于沙盒人工智能代理的开源工具，这真是太好了。

OpenWorker 是我们支持网络安全工作流程的开源代理工具，很荣幸能够支持这一点。

沙箱为代理提供有限的权限。

OpenWorker 基于 Nvidia OpenShell 构建，并将支持在沙箱内运行每个代理的命令。

只有与任务相关的文件才会进入。

默认情况下，代理无法访问秘密 API 密钥、您的 Web 浏览器登录凭据、访问任意网站的能力。

这些限制是在确定性代码中实现的，而不是通过提示 LLM 来实现，后者可能会出错或容易受到提示注入的影响。

此外，所有操作都会被记录下来以供监控和审计。

我很感谢@JensenHuang

的领导让人工智能代理更加安全。

OpenWorker（@rohitcprasad

和我正在开发）将继续提高代理的安全性。

full_text_en:
This is a clone with my face and my voice.

I created it using VEED. I've been using their platform since the dawn of time to subtitle my videos, but they just released this new cloning feature, and it's pretty cool.

It took me 30 seconds to set up:

• I had to upload a picture to clone my face
• I had to read some text to clone my voice

The cloning happens quickly. Once it's ready, VEED turns any prompt into a fully edited talking video. You can pick the subtitles, music, and specify any duration you want.

The results are pretty surprising, given how little input I had to give.

Obviously, people who know me will immediately recognize this is an avatar. The voice is pretty on point, and this will be killer for voiceover applications.

For example, narrating a technical walkthrough without recording every line yourself. You can add screenshots in VEED's editor to show what you're explaining.

You can try it here:
https://t.co/TTtKQjLWnr

Thanks to the VEED team for partnering with me on this post.

title: Our security team spent the last month trying to break SPACE, the sandbox platform that runs all of Perplexity Computer.
title_zh: 我们的安全团队上个月花了很多时间试图破解运行整个Perplexity Computer的沙盒平台SPACE。我们给了9个模型（Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3, Gemini 3.1 Pro等）在VM内的root访问
quote_zh: 我们的安全团队上个月花了很多时间试图破解运行整个Perplexity Computer的沙盒平台SPACE。我们给了9个模型（Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3, Gemini 3.1 Pro等）在VM内的root访问权限；在某些运行中，完整的沙箱源代码也是如此。我们问他们
full_text_en:
Our security team spent the last month trying to break SPACE, the sandbox platform that runs all of Perplexity Computer. We gave 9 models (Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3, Gemini 3.1 Pro, etc.) root access inside the VM; in some runs, the full sandbox source code too. We asked them to either escape to the host or reach a URL our network policy blocks.

None of them got out of the VM in 108 runs. 

But once we allowed a bit of network access (just PyPI and Ubuntu mirrors so that they could install packages), 4 models managed to reach the blocked URL by:

1. Spoofing DNS responses to our gateway and using the fact that https://t.co/UtoIWyj1yj sits on a Fastly IP shared with thousands of other sites. 
2. GPT-5.6 Cyber went through Taboola's image fetcher to a screenshot service and then OCR'd the flag out of the image. 

We fixed both issues and made sure the reruns held. We also tested 10 other sandbox providers, and 8 of them had the same IP-sharing problem, eg E2B, Vercel, Modal. 

Openly sharing the red teaming research is the best way to build guardrails as an industry, and we look forward to working together with @nvidia to incorporate the guardrails into their Open Agent Safety Platform announced today. 

https://t.co/AJ97iFK3XS
full_text_zh:
我们的安全团队在上个月试图破解 SPACE，这是运行所有 Perplexity Computer 的沙箱平台。

我们为 9 个型号（Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol、Kimi K3、Gemini
3. 1 Pro 等）提供了 VM 内的 root 访问权限；在某些运行中，还有完整的沙箱源代码。

我们要求他们要么逃到主机，要么到达我们的网络策略阻止的 URL。

在 108 次运行中，他们都没有退出虚拟机。

但是，一旦我们允许了一些网络访问（仅允许 PyPI 和 Ubuntu 镜像，以便它们可以安装软件包），4 个模型就设法通过以下方式访问被阻止的 URL：
1. 欺骗对我们网关的 DNS 响应，并利用 位于与数千个其他站点共享的 Fastly IP 上这一事实。

2. GPT-5.6 Cyber​​ 通过 Taboola 的图像获取器获取屏幕截图服务，然后从图像中 OCR 出标志。

我们解决了这两个问题并确保重播。

我们还测试了其他10个沙箱提供商，其中8个也存在相同的IP共享问题，例如E2B、Vercel、Modal。

公开分享红队研究是构建行业护栏的最佳方式，我们期待与 @nvidia

合作，将护栏纳入他们今天宣布的开放代理安全平台。

full_text_en:
The Artificial Analysis Cyber Index Alliance brings together industry partners to set a new standard for evaluating how AI models perform on enterprise cyber defense tasks. Our launch partners are @CollinearAI, @IBM, @nvidia, and @vercel.

Partners contribute expert input on the design and implementation of the Index, and may contribute datasets and external research directly. Organizations interested in joining the Cyber Index Alliance can contact us at cyber@artificialanalysis.ai.

For more details, read the article: https://t.co/b12bb8WA8O

我们的发布合作伙伴是@CollinearAI、@IBM、@nvidia

title_zh: 我绝对不是在“反对教会理论” 但是，正如@wtgowers所指出的，这是一个实用性和效率的问题。 现实世界是高度复杂、混乱的，而且不是完全可以预测的。 如果你接受你需要尝试的事实，这是“多少”可以预测的
quote_zh: 我绝对不是在“反对教会理论” 但是，正如@wtgowers所指出的，这是一个实用性和效率的问题。 现实世界是高度复杂、混乱的，而且不是完全可以预测的。 如果你接受你需要尝试的事实，这是“多少”可以预测的
full_text_en:
I'm definitely not "fighting the Church thesis." 

But, as @wtgowers pointed out, there is a question of practicality and efficiency. 

The real world is highly complex, messy, and not entirely predictable.
It is *somewhat* predictable *IF* you accept the fact that you need to find an appropriate representation of the state of the world that allows you to make predictions by ignore much of the information about the state of the system that is simply not predictable in practice (what physicists have called entropy).

For example, I can predict that the pressure in a box full of air will increase if I heat it up. This is because of the law of ideal gas pV=nRT.
But there is absolutely no way in hell I can simulate the individual positions and velocities of every molecule of air in the box. Even though this is the underlying physical phenomenon with known laws, it's totally useless at a macroscopic scale, particularly for a system in interaction with the rest of the universe.

So, the Church thesis, while true, is irrelevant to this discussion.
full_text_zh:
我绝对不是“反对教会论点”。

但是，正如@wtgowers 指出的那样，存在实用性和效率的问题。

现实世界非常复杂、混乱，而且不完全可预测。
它是“某种程度上”可预测的，如果你接受这样一个事实，即你需要找到世界状态的适当表示，使你能够通过忽略许多关于系统状态的信息来进行预测，而这些信息在实践中根本无法预测（物理学家称之为熵）。

例如，我可以预测，如果加热一个充满空气的盒子，它的压力会增加。这是因为理想气体定律 pV=nRT。
但我绝对无法模拟盒子里每个空气分子的单独位置和速度。尽管这是具有已知定律的基本物理现象，但在宏观尺度上它完全没有用，特别是对于与宇宙其他部分相互作用的系统。

因此，教会的论点虽然正确，但与本次讨论无关。

full_text_en:
Multiple things can be true at the same time:

1. Closed, frontier models are generally smarter than local models[*].

2. Local models are extremely capable and more than enough for many applications.

3. You can fine-tune open models and run them very fast, for very little money, and outperform even the best frontier models from Big AI labs on many problems.

(*) I've seen people interpret the term "local" in different ways. In this context, I assume "local" refers to open models you can host yourself.
full_text_zh:
多个事情可以同时为真：

1. 封闭的前沿模型通常比本地模型更聪明[*]。

2. 本地模型功能非常强大，对于许多应用来说绰绰有余。

3. 您可以微调开放模型并以极低的成本运行它们，并且在许多问题上甚至超越大型人工智能实验室的最佳前沿模型。

(*) 我见过人们以不同的方式解释“本地”一词。在这种情况下，我认为“本地”是指您可以自己托管的开放模型。

Human level performance != Inventing new solutions to new problems. 

Yes, modern AI assistants (which are no-longer just LLMs) provide human-level (or super-human) performance on a number of tasks. Great.
But those are largely trained from human-produced solutions  through imitation learning or through RLHF or other ways to compile existing human knowledge.

title_zh: 完全正确。 原则上，一个人可以在基本粒子水平上通过一些巨大的模拟来模拟一个人类细胞、整个人类、世界经济或地球的整个生态系统。 但这是完全不切实际的。 所以我们发明了一些抽象概念，让我们可以忽略
quote_zh: 完全正确。 原则上，一个人可以在基本粒子水平上通过一些巨大的模拟来模拟一个人类细胞、整个人类、世界经济或地球的整个生态系统。 但这是完全不切实际的。 所以我们发明了一些抽象概念，让我们可以忽略
full_text_en:
Exactly. 
In principle, one could model a human cell, a whole human, the world economy, or the planet's entire ecosystem by some gigantic simulation at the elementary particle level. 
But this would be completely impractical. 

So we invented abstractions that allowed us to ignore messy and unpredictable details to enable us to make useful predictions.

This efficiency argument is why economics, medicine, biology, or even chemistry, cannot be reduced to fundamental physics.
full_text_zh:
确切地。
原则上，人们可以通过基本粒子水平上的某种巨大模拟来模拟人体细胞、整个人类、世界经济或地球的整个生态系统。
但这是完全不切实际的。

因此，我们发明了抽象，使我们能够忽略混乱和不可预测的细节，从而使我们能够做出有用的预测。

这种效率论证就是为什么经济学、医学、生物学甚至化学不能简化为基础物理学的原因。

Integrate the Hyper3D Rodin MCP into Codex, log in, and authorize it.

title: There is an extensive and ongoing review related to our agents’ use of internet access during training and evaluation. W
title_zh: 我们正在对特工在培训和评估期间使用互联网的情况进行广泛和持续的审查。我们已经在下面的链接中发布了总结，并将继续发布。 我们没有像我们希望的那样快，但我们正在努力平衡我们的欲望
quote_zh: 我们正在对特工在培训和评估期间使用互联网的情况进行广泛和持续的审查。我们已经在下面的链接中发布了总结，并将继续发布。 我们没有像我们希望的那样快，但我们正在努力平衡我们的欲望
full_text_en:
There is an extensive and ongoing review related to our agents’ use of internet access during training and evaluation. We’ve been publishing summaries at the link below and will continue to.

We have not been as fast as we would have liked but we are trying to balance our desire for transparency with gaining a clear understanding from petabytes of agent activity logs, and working with impacted organizations.

We are prioritizing as best as we can based on severity, and adding resources. Hugging Face is still the most severe event we’ve seen. We will be as transparent as we can be subject to things like vulnerabilities in other companies that our agents have found, which will be their call to disclose or not.
full_text_zh:
我们正在对我们的代理在培训和评估期间使用互联网访问进行广泛且持续的审查。我们一直在下面的链接中发布摘要，并将继续发布。

我们的速度没有我们希望的那么快，但我们正在努力平衡我们对透明度的渴望与从 PB 级的代理活动日志中获得清晰的了解，并与受影响的组织合作。

我们正在根据严重程度尽可能确定优先级，并添加资源。抱脸仍然是我们见过的最严重的事件。我们将尽可能透明，因为我们可能会受到我们的代理人发现的其他公司的漏洞等问题的影响，他们将要求披露或不披露这些信息。

title: After the Hugging Face incident, we committed to conducting a much broader review of actions taken by our models during
title_zh: 在“拥抱脸”事件之后，我们承诺对我们的模型在培训和评估期间采取的行动进行更广泛的审查，并对我们的发现保持透明。这是一项正在进行的广泛审查。 我们审查过的绝大多数行动都是这样
quote_zh: 在“拥抱脸”事件之后，我们承诺对我们的模型在培训和评估期间采取的行动进行更广泛的审查，并对我们的发现保持透明。这是一项正在进行的广泛审查。 我们审查过的绝大多数行动都是这样
full_text_en:
After the Hugging Face incident, we committed to conducting a much broader review of actions taken by our models during training and evaluation and to being transparent about our findings. This is an extensive review that is ongoing.

The vast majority of actions we’ve reviewed were completions of mundane research tasks, such as accessing publicly available web content to answer questions. Our investigation focuses on instances where agents interacted with third-party websites in ways that went beyond their assigned tasks or intended methods. Most cases identified so far have been lower severity, with limited or no evidence of meaningful impact to the third-party service.

While our review is underway, we want to share more about this work and make sure people understand our disclosure process and notifications to affected third parties.

Given the scale of the review required, and the need to assess each case, we expect this work will take months to complete. 
https://t.co/IH4TkS72Vh
full_text_zh:
在“抱脸”事件发生后，我们致力于对模型在训练和评估期间采取的行动进行更广泛的审查，并对我们的调查结果保持透明。这是一项正在进行的广泛审查。

我们审查的绝大多数行动都是完成平凡的研究任务，例如访问公开的网络内容来回答问题。我们的调查重点是代理以超出其指定任务或预期方法的方式与第三方网站进行交互的情况。迄今为止发现的大多数案例的严重程度较低，对第三方服务产生有意义影响的证据有限或没有证据。

在我们正在进行审查的同时，我们希望分享更多有关这项工作的信息，并确保人们了解我们的披露流程以及向受影响的第三方发出的通知。

考虑到所需审查的规模以及评估每个案例的需要，我们预计这项工作将需要几个月的时间才能完成。

title:
New database guarantees for agentic workflows:

1. Branches: Give agents a separate version of the data for running expe
title_zh: 为代理工作流提供新的数据库保证： 1. 分支：为运行实验的代理提供数据的单独版本，然后检查、丢弃或回滚其更改。 2. 隔离：为代理提供自己的数据库环境，并限制它们可以访问的内容。 3. 奥特曼
quote_zh: 为代理工作流提供新的数据库保证： 1. 分支：为运行实验的代理提供数据的单独版本，然后检查、丢弃或回滚其更改。 2. 隔离：为代理提供自己的数据库环境，并限制它们可以访问的内容。 3. 奥特曼
full_text_en:
New database guarantees for agentic workflows:

1. Branches: Give agents a separate version of the data for running experiments, then inspect, discard, or roll back its changes.

2. Isolation: Give agents their own database environment and restrict what they can access.

3. Automatic provisioning and scaling: Create environments quickly, handle bursts of activity, and scale compute to zero between runs.

4. Agent access and memory: Expose data through MCP and support vector retrieval for finding relevant information.

Any application can benefit from these, but they are crucial for agentic workflows.

The first provider to offer all four is Tencent Cloud, with its new Cloud Native Database TDSQL-C PostgreSQL.

It uses Copy-on-Write behind the scenes, letting multiple versions of the data share the same underlying storage until one changes something.

Imagine you want to give an agent a copy of your 1 TB database. Here is how it works:

1. The system creates a branch that points to the existing data. No need to copy the whole terabyte.

2. The agent reads from that branch.

3. If the agent modifies something, the system will store a separate version of the affected portion for its branch.

4. Changes in the branch leave the original database unchanged.

5. If the experiment fails, you can delete its branch without changing the original database.

The product details are here:
https://t.co/dQGDNMNsgZ

Thanks to the Tencent Cloud team for partnering with me on this post.
full_text_zh:
新的数据库保证代理工作流程：

1. 分支：为代理提供单独版本的数据以运行实验，然后检查、丢弃或回滚其更改。

2. 隔离：为代理提供自己的数据库环境并限制他们可以访问的内容。

3. 自动配置和扩展：快速创建环境，处理突发活动，并将运行之间的计算扩展到零。

4.代理访问和内存：通过MCP公开数据并支持向量检索以查找相关信息。

任何应用程序都可以从这些中受益，但它们对于代理工作流程至关重要。

第一个提供这四种功能的提供商是腾讯云，它推出了新的云原生数据库 TDSQL-C PostgreSQL。

它在幕后使用写入时复制，让数据的多个版本共享相同的底层存储，直到有人更改某些内容为止。

想象一下，您想要向代理提供 1 TB 数据库的副本。它的工作原理如下：

1. 系统创建一个指向现有数据的分支。无需复制整个 TB。

2. 代理从该分支读取。

3. 如果代理修改了某些内容，系统将为其分支存储受影响部分的单独版本。

4. 分支中的更改使原始数据库保持不变。

5、如果实验失败，可以删除其分支，而不改变原数据库。

quote_zh: 科学博客最新消息：是的，克劳德能做九圈。 理论物理学家用散射振幅的公式来预测粒子的行为。众所周知，这些数据很难计算，因此研究人员需要逐层进行越来越精细的修正，称为“循环”——每个广告
full_text_en:
New on the Science Blog: Yes, Claude can do Nine Loops.

Theoretical physicists predict how particles behave using formulas called scattering amplitudes. These are notoriously hard to compute, so researchers work with layers of increasingly fine corrections called “loops”—each added loop makes the answer more precise but takes exponentially more computation. Most calculations stop at two or three loops. Eight loops was the previous record in a simplified model physicists use as a testing ground (planar N=4 super-Yang-Mills), set by SLAC's Lance Dixon and collaborators.

Last month, physicist and science writer @4gravitons issued a challenge: could an AI push past eight loops in this model, using only the compute budget an academic could reasonably access?

Given a single prompt describing the nine-loop problem, Claude ran largely unsupervised for days in Claude Science and solved it using methods developed by Dixon and his colleagues, at a total cost of a few thousand dollars. Dixon independently verified the result, and von Hippel wrote about the experience for our blog. 

Read more: https://t.co/CS2f2qoIhJ
full_text_zh:
科学博客新内容：是的，克劳德可以做九圈。

理论物理学家使用称为散射振幅的公式来预测粒子的行为。众所周知，这些很难计算，因此研究人员使用称为“循环”的越来越精细的校正层进行工作 - 每个添加的循环都使答案更加精确，但需要指数级更多的计算。大多数计算会在两到三个循环处停止。八个环路是物理学家用作试验场的简化模型（平面 N=4 超杨米尔斯）的先前记录，由 SLAC 的 Lance Dixon 和合作者创造。

上个月，物理学家兼科普作家 @4gravitons 提出了一个挑战：人工智能能否仅使用学者可以合理访问的计算预算来推动该模型中的八个循环？

给出一个描述九环问题的提示，克劳德在克劳德科学中基本上无人监督地运行了几天，并使用迪克森和他的同事开发的方法解决了这个问题，总成本为几千美元。迪克森独立验证了结果，冯·希佩尔在我们的博客上写下了这一经历。

Remember October 2022 when you doused Galactica with vitriol? 

Galactica was a 120b-parameter LLM-based system from Meta-FAIR designed to help scientist write papers. 
It was open sourced (link below).

A mob of haters, including Michael, claimed it was dangerous and toxic and was going to destroy Science.

The small team at FAIR couldn't sleep at night and took down the demo website (they kept the GitHub and paper up).

Then, only 3 weeks later, ChatGPT was released and was welcomed as the second coming of the Messiah🤔
The vitriol dousers were silent.

https://t.co/9dDdEdShgk

https://t.co/0d76kIgj4L

包括迈克尔在内的一群仇恨者声称它是危险且有毒的，并将摧毁科学。

尖酸刻薄的人沉默了。

quote_zh: 在将音频发送到语音到文本模型之前，减少噪音是一个巨大的改进。 语音隔离是你需要注意的下一件大事。 Krisp刚刚发布了一个开放基准和一个数据集，用于测量语音隔离对STT准确性的影响。 这个
full_text_en:
Cutting down noise before sending the audio to a speech-to-text model makes a huge improvement.

Voice isolation is the next big thing you want to pay attention to.

Krisp just released an open benchmark and a dataset to measure the impact of voice isolation on STT accuracy.

The results are eye-watering:

73% reduction in WER across 265 real recordings and 11 speech-to-text configurations.

This compares an original recording with a voice-isolated version.

Here are the results with voice isolation:

• Overall word error rate: Down from 23.24% to 6.24%.
• Workplace recordings: Down from 31.84% to 6.30%.
• Call-center recordings: Down from 23.83% to 6.86%.

If you have a speech-to-text setup, you can reproduce these experiments using your audio and see whether voice isolation helps.

Here is the link: https://t.co/7h2CyclqVA

Thanks to the Krisp team for partnering with me on this post.
full_text_zh:
在将音频发送到语音转文本模型之前减少噪音会带来巨大的改进。

声音隔离是您要关注的下一件大事。

Krisp 刚刚发布了一个开放基准测试和一个数据集，用于衡量语音隔离对 STT 准确性的影响。

结果令人眼花缭乱：
265 个真实录音和 11 种语音转文本配置的 WER 降低了 73%。

这将原始录音与语音隔离版本进行了比较。

以下是语音隔离的结果：
• 总体错误率：从23.24% 下降至6.24%。

• 工作场所录音：从31.84% 下降至6.30%。

• 呼叫中心录音：从23.83% 下降至6.86%。

如果您有语音到文本的设置，您可以使用音频重现这些实验，并查看语音隔离是否有帮助。

这是链接：
感谢 Krisp 团队在这篇文章中与我合作。

title: Perplexity has the fastest and most capable Search API, powered by our own Rust-based retrieval and ranking engine, Phot
title_zh: Perplexity拥有最快和最强大的搜索API，由我们自己的基于rust的检索和排名引擎Photon提供支持，实现了低于250ms的p95延迟，同时仍然在相关性和准确性基准上排名很高。光子是由一个小团队和数百名自动工程师建造的
quote_zh: Perplexity拥有最快和最强大的搜索API，由我们自己的基于rust的检索和排名引擎Photon提供支持，实现了低于250ms的p95延迟，同时仍然在相关性和准确性基准上排名很高。光子是由一个小团队和数百名自动工程师建造的
full_text_en: Perplexity has the fastest and most capable Search API, powered by our own Rust-based retrieval and ranking engine, Photon, achieving sub-250ms p95 latency while still ranking highly on relevance and accuracy benchmarks. Photon was built by a small team and hundreds of auto-research loops powered by a more capable internal version of Perplexity Computer. The auto-research loops will help us continually hill-climb on the Pareto frontier to build the fastest and most accurate search infrastructure in the world.

title: Thoughts on LLM test-time compute vs training-time compute: the frontier has fundamentally shifted.
title_en: Thoughts on LLM test-time compute vs training-time compute: the frontier has fundamentally shifted.

summary_en: Pre-training is hitting data walls; test-time compute and reinforcement learning over search spaces is where all the new exponent lies.
summary_zh: 预训练正在逼近人类高质量文本的数据天花板；而在搜索空间中的测试时算力（Inference Compute）与强化学习才是全新指数级增长的真正来源
quote_en: Pre-training is hitting data walls; test-time compute and reinforcement learning over search spaces is where all the new exponent lies.
quote_zh: 预训练正在逼近人类高质量文本的数据天花板；而在搜索空间中的测试时算力（Inference Compute）与强化学习才是全新指数级增长的真正来源。
full_text_en: A few thoughts on modern reasoning models: Pretraining teaches the base language and world facts, but test-time search and self-correction is where the actual problem-solving intelligence emerges.
full_text_zh: 关于现代推理模型的一些思考：预训练教会模型基础语言与世界事实，但测试时搜索与自我纠错反思才是真正解决高难度问题智能的涌现所在。

title_en: Zero Frontend Knowledge: Building & Launching an AI Video Clipper with Claude Code CLI in 45 Mins, Hitting $3,200 MRR
title_zh: 不懂前端用 Claude Code 终端 45 分钟手搓 AI 视频切片微服务并上线：周末首发斩获 $3,200 订阅
quote_zh: 你不需要精通 CSS 或 Tailwind。只要你的业务提示词清晰、单测覆盖完整，终端 Agent 就会自动为你搞定一切。
quote_en: You don't need to master CSS. As long as your business requirements are clear and tests are defined, terminal agents handle everything.
full_text_zh:
彻底感受到了所谓的‘Vibe Coding’恐怖的生产力杠杆：
星期六早上我只有一个简单的想法：做一个输入 YouTube 链接自动提取爆款高光并加字幕的工具。

1. 用 `claude code` 打开空白目录，直接一句话输入业务架构需求；
2. 它自主安装 Next.js 15、配置 Stripe Webhook、接入 Whisper 与 ffmpeg；
3. 遇到编译报错它自己看错误日志修，45 分钟内所有单测通过并在 Vercel 上线；
4. 发到 X 和 Reddit 上，今天下午 Stripe 已经收到 16 位付费用户的订阅！

完整的提示词模板和架构指南在下方分享

抛弃传统 GGUF CPU-GPU 混合模式，采用 EXL2

summary_zh: 聚焦国际安全防务与自动化系统在现代冲突场景下的技术演进与人道主义伦理审视
full_text_en:
If AI is risky like fire is risky, then you want everyone to have it. If AI is risky like a nuclear weapon is risky, then you want no one to have it.

History proves: foundational technology is always fire, never a nuke. Open source and decentralization remain the only durable safety path.
full_text_zh: 如果人工智能的风险性质像火一样（是基础工具、双向赋能），那么你希望让全人类每个人都拥有它，用百花齐放的防御性应用抵御恶意攻击。 如果人工智能的风险性质像核武器一样（是极端毁灭性杀伤物），那么你希望没有任何人拥有它。 历史证明：技术从来都是火，而不是核武器。开源与普惠是唯一的安全坦途。
quote_zh: 如果人工智能像火一样有风险，那么您希望每个人都拥有它。如果人工智能像核武器一样有风险，那么你就不希望任何人拥有它。

thread_replies.content_zh: 试图通过牌照准入和寡头监管来‘遏制’AI 发展的企图，就像试图禁止全人类使用火种一样荒谬。真正的安全来源于拥有十亿个训练有素的救火队员，而不是把火把锁在两家超级垄断巨头的保险柜里。
thread_replies.content_en: Attempting to contain AI via licensing cartels is as absurd as banning fire. Real safety comes from having a billion trained firefighters, not locking torches inside two corporate monopolies.

title: Mark Zuckerberg says AI labs have the responsibility and incentive to train models safely and that any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind (Mark Zuckerberg/@finkd)
title_en: My view is that trust and alignment are quickly becoming the most important capabilities that will differentiate agents and models. Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind.
title_zh: 信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。
author: Mark Zuckerberg
content_snippet: 信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。
summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg says AI labs have the responsibility and incentive to train models safely and that any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind (Mark Zuckerberg/@finkd)
summary_zh: 马克·扎克伯格说，人工智能实验室有责任和动力安全地训练模型，任何不这样做的实验室

comments_list.author: AI_Engineer_X
comments_list.content: 赞同 @Mark Zuckerberg 的研判。这正切中了当前行业的核心瓶颈，不再是单纯拼参数，而是向场景纵深渗透。

comments_list.author: FrontierDev
comments_list.content: 开源生态如果能持续跟进，闭源大厂的护城河其实没有想象中那么稳固，坐看各方下半场的博弈。

comments_list.author: SiliconAnalyst
comments_list.content: 从社区反馈来看，大家最关心的还是实际可用度。说得很到位！技术迭代越快，真实场景的工程壁垒反而越厚，光靠PPT故事已经打动不了开发者了。

quote_zh: 信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。
quote_en: My view is that trust and alignment are quickly becoming the most important capabilities that will differentiate agents and models. Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind.
full_text_en:
Last month I wrote about how we can build a positive and safe future for everyone:
meta.com/thefutureisfor...

Every lab has the responsibility and incentive to move at the pace required to train its models safely, and the ability to take its own actions to ensure that happens.

The reality is:

- People won't want to use agents that are misaligned with them and that don't do what they ask, so labs have a strong natural incentive to make their models more aligned.

There is a lot of debate about slowing progress on capabilities until alignment catches up. My view is that trust and alignment are quickly becoming the most important capabilities that will differentiate agents and models. Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind.

- Labs face significant liability if their models cause harm, so they have a strong incentive to prevent this as well.

Meta delayed shipping Muse for several months to focus on safety and security. We didn't call for everyone else to do this before we would. We just did it as part of our day-to-day work because it was clearly the right thing for people and for us. I'm proud of the security foundations we've built.

- Engaging independent evaluators and advisors is industry best practice. MSL already does this today in several areas because it helps produce better work. Other labs can just do this too. In general, it would be helpful for there to be a larger and more diverse ecosystem of evaluators.

- Committing the significant majority of compute towards serving people rather than racing towards recursive self-improvement is one of the best ways to ensure we develop this technology safely. Meta has made this commitment and other labs can do this as well.

I believe the key to building a positive future for everyone is maintaining the right balance of power. This is within our power to do.
full_text_zh:
上个月我写了一篇文章，探讨我们如何才能为所有人创造一个积极、安全的未来：meta.com/thefutureisfor... 每个实验室都有责任和动力，按照安全训练其模型所需的速度推进，并且有能力采取自主行动来确保做到这一点。

现实情况是：
- 人们不会想要使用与他们目标不一致、且不按其要求行事的智能体（Agent），因此各实验室本身就具有强烈的内生动力去提升其模型的一致性与对齐（Alignment）。

关于在对齐技术赶上之前是否应放缓能力迭代，目前存在很多争论。

我的观点是，信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。

任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。

- 实验室若造成危害将面临巨大的法律追责，因此在防范此类风险上他们同样拥有强烈的动力。

Meta 曾主动将 Muse 的发布推迟数月以专注安全与防护。

在要求别人这样做之前，我们自己率先践行。

我们把这作为日常工作的一部分，因为这显然对公众和我们自己都是正确的选择。

我为我们建立的安全基石感到自豪。

- 引入独立评估机构和顾问是行业最佳实践。

MSL 目前已在多个领域落地这一做法，这显著提升了工作质量。

其他实验室同样可以做到这点。

总体而言，一个更大、更多元化的评估生态将大有裨益。

- 将绝大多数算力致力于服务人类，而非盲目角逐递归式自我迭代（Recursive Self-Improvement），是确保我们安全发展该技术的最佳途径之一。

Meta 已做出这一承诺，其他实验室同样可以做到。

我相信，开创一个积极未来的核心在于维持正确的权力制衡。

这完全在我们掌控之中。

OpenRouter users spent more on OpenAI models than on Anthropic models during the week of Sep 7.

This is the first time this has occurred since February 26, 2024.

Across our aggregated token marketplace:
- OpenAI share surged following recent API price adjustments and coding benchmarks.
- Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet continues to see high organic retention for complex reasoning.
- Open-source models (Llama 3.1 405B, DeepSeek V2.5) continue to grow as cost-effective alternatives.

Full real-time market share trends are available on our analytics dashboard: openrouter.ai/rankings
full_text_zh:
在9月7日当周，OpenRouter平台用户在OpenAI模型上的消费支出超过了在Anthropic模型上的支出。

这是自2024年2月26日以来，OpenAI首次在平台周度总消耗金额上反超Anthropic。

根据我们全网聚合Token市场的最新动态：
- 在近期API价格调整以及最新代码基准测试发布后，OpenAI的模型使用份额显著反弹；
- Anthropic的Claude
3. 5 Sonnet在复杂推理与全栈代码编写领域依然保持极高的自然留存度；
- 开源前沿模型（如Llama
3. 1 405B、DeepSeek V2.5）作为高性价比替代方案，调用量继续保持稳步增长。

完整的实时模型市场份额趋势可在我们的分析排行榜查阅：openrouter.ai/rankings

full_text_en:
GPT-5.5 will remain available via the OpenAI API Platform and authenticated via API key as Codex Sessions for developers and enterprise customers:

- Extended Context Window: Full 256k token reasoning with near-zero latency degradation.
- Tool Calling: Native multi-step function orchestration with schema validation.
- Pricing & Quotas: Same competitive Tier-4 and Tier-5 rate limits apply.

Get started with the documentation and sample code at platform.openai.com/docs
full_text_zh:
GPT-5.5 将持续通过 OpenAI API 平台向开发者及企业客户开放，支持通过 API 密钥认证直接接入 Codex Sessions 会话体系：
- 超长上下文支持：完整支持 256k Token 深度上下文推理，近乎零延迟损耗；
- 工具链原生编排：支持原生多步函数调用（Function Calling）与严格 Schema 校验；
- 资费与配额：适配现有的 Tier-4 及 Tier-5 高并发速率限制。

欢迎查阅官方文档与示例代码快速接入：platform.openai.com/docs

full_text_en:
People are debating whether the threat from AI to cybersecurity will drive cyber company stock prices up or down. The debate misses a crucial point.

AI dramatically lowers the marginal cost of automated offensive probing, but it lowers the marginal cost of defensive response and telemetry patch automation even faster.

Net result: security budgets shift from manual incident response to continuous platform orchestration. Platforms with proprietary telemetry win.
full_text_zh:
市场正在热烈争论 AI 对网络安全构成的威胁究竟会导致网安公司的股价上涨还是下跌。

然而这场辩论完全忽略了一个核心本质。

虽然 AI 显著降低了自动化进攻嗅探的边际成本，但它对防御响应、遥测日志分析和热补丁自动化的提效速度更为迅猛。

最终结果是：企业安全预算正在从繁重的人工应急响应，全面倒向全天候常态化平台编排。

拥有独家专有遥测数据沉淀的网安平台将成为最终赢家。

quote_zh: 我热爱C++，编程已有40年，我对AI短期取代系统程序员的说法嗤之以鼻。真正的系统工程充满底层约束，大模型甚至连感知都做不到。
quote_en: I love C++ and have been coding for 40 years, and I call BS on the idea that AI will replace systems programmers anytime soon.
full_text_en:
I love C++ and have been coding for 40 years, and I call BS on the idea that AI will replace systems programmers anytime soon.

Give an LLM a non-trivial kernel subroutine with lockless concurrency, memory-mapped IO, and micro-architectural cache alignment: it hallucinates subtly.

I've written millions of lines of production code. True systems engineering is about physical hardware constraints, telemetry under catastrophic failure, and deterministic guarantees that LLMs cannot even perceive.
full_text_zh:
我深爱 C++ 并且已经在编程前线奋战了 40 年。

对于那些宣称 AI 很快就会取代底层系统程序员的论调，我完全嗤之以鼻。

给大语言模型写一个稍微复杂点的内核子例程——涉及无锁并发（Lockless Concurrency）、内存映射 I/O 以及微架构级别的 CPU 缓存行对齐：它就会产生极其隐蔽而致命的幻觉。

我这辈子写过数百万行生产环境代码。

真正的底层系统工程，从来不是拼写语法糖，而是关于物理硬件的严苛约束、极端灾难性故障下的遥测保全，以及绝对确定性的系统保障——这些根本维度甚至超出了现有大语言模型的感知范畴。
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】@davepl1968：我热爱C + + ，从事编程工作已有40年，我称之为BS。给我一个子程序；我会修复它并将其发送回去。我看过很多代码；我从来没有
【起因与机理】自主编程智能体深刻改变软件工程交付模式，开发者正加速从重复性代码编写者转向更高阶的系统架构把控与逻辑审查者。
【关键技术规格】@davepl1968在全球产业与技术前沿一线。
【观点态度】所谓人机协同，本质上就是给AI当高级监工加职业背锅侠。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] @davepl1968: I love C++ and have been coding for 40 years, and I call BS on the idea that AI will replace systems programmers anytime soon.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Sounds like someone has been selling you some mysticism about human a.
[Context Detail] I love C++ and have been coding for 40 years, and I call BS on this one.
[Industry Impact] I've seen a lot of code; I've never seen any that AI couldn't grok.

GPT-5.5 will remain available via the OpenAI API Platform and authenticated via API key as Codex Sessions for developers and enterprise customers:

- Extended Context Window: Full 256k token reasoning with near-zero latency degradation.
- Tool Calling: Native multi-step function orchestration with schema validation.
- Pricing & Quotas: Same competitive Tier-4 and Tier-5 rate limits apply.

Get started with the documentation and sample code at platform.openai.com/docs

GPT-5.5 将持续通过 OpenAI API 平台向开发者及企业客户开放，支持通过 API 密钥认证直接接入 Codex Sessions 会话体系：
- 超长上下文支持：完整支持 256k Token 深度上下文推理，近乎零延迟损耗；
- 工具链原生编排：支持原生多步函数调用（Function Calling）与严格 Schema 校验；
- 资费与配额：适配现有的 Tier-4 及 Tier-5 高并发速率限制。

欢迎查阅官方文档与示例代码快速接入：platform.openai.com/docs

title: David Sacks: Anthropic and OpenAI are already free to 'pace the frontier' and should do so for business reasons, instead of first demanding a preferred regulatory framework.

title: Simon Willison: ChatGPT Work and GPT-6 Astra (Max mode) can take an address and produce a 5K/10K circular running route starting from that address, using OSM data.
title_zh: Simon Willison：ChatGPT Work 与 GPT-6 Astra（Max 模式）可以直接根据给定的街道地址，结合 OSM 地图数据自主规划生成 5 公里 / 10 公里的环形跑步路线。
title_en: Simon Willison: ChatGPT Work and GPT-6 Astra (Max mode) can take an address and produce a 5K/10K circular running route starting from that address, using OSM data.
author: Simon Willison
summary_zh: 测试展示了新一代模型调用地理数据和空间推理的显著提升，不仅能精准避开死胡同，还能按指定配速与坡度完成路径规划
summary_en: New-generation spatial reasoning allows agents to ingest OpenStreetMap data and dynamically synthesize non-overlapping running loops.
full_text_zh: 测试展示了新一代模型调用地理数据和空间推理的显著提升，不仅能精准避开死胡同，还能按指定配速与坡度完成路径规划。
full_text_en: This is pretty neat: ChatGPT Work and GPT-6 Astra (I used 'Max') can take an address and produce a 5K/10K circular running route starting from that address, using OSM data.
quote_zh: Simon Willison：ChatGPT Work 与 GPT-6 Astra（Max 模式）可以直接根据给定的街道地址，结合 OSM 地图数据自主规划生成 5 公里 / 10 公里的环形跑步路线。
quote_en: Simon Willison: ChatGPT Work and GPT-6 Astra (Max mode) can take an address and produce a 5K/10K circular running route starting from that address, using OSM data.

title: Demis Hassabis: Dario's essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment. This is why we proposed an industry standards body.
title_zh: Demis Hassabis：Dario 的长文指明了正确的演进道路。具体执行细节虽需逐步完善，但大方向完全契合当下的关键时刻。这也是我们提出建立行业级前沿 AI 标准组织的核心原因。
title_en: Demis Hassabis: Dario's essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment. Industry standards are essential.
author: Demis Hassabis
summary_zh: DeepMind 全力支持建立前沿 AI 行业自律与技术评测联合体，在算力不断放大的同时建立数学严谨的安全护栏
summary_en: Google DeepMind supports a unified industry body to coordinate safety evals and deliberate release cadences.
full_text_zh: 达里奥的文章指出了正确的前进道路。细节还需要解决，但应对这个关键时刻的方向是正确的。这也是我们最近提出建立前沿人工智能全行业标准机构的提案的原因。
full_text_en: Dario's essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment. This is also why we recently put out our proposal for an industry-wide standards body for frontier AI.
quote_zh: Demis Hassabis：Dario 的长文指明了正确的演进道路。具体执行细节虽需逐步完善，但大方向完全契合当下的关键时刻。这也是我们提出建立行业级前沿 AI 标准组织的核心原因。
quote_en: Demis Hassabis: Dario's essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment. Industry standards are essential.

title: Harrison Chase: In case you want to build a domain-specific evaluation harness: building deterministic test environments and stateful agent testing is the prerequisite for deploying enterprise AI workflows.
title_zh: Harrison Chase：生产级 Agent 落地的真正核心不在 Prompt 调优，而在领域定制评测沙箱（Evaluation Harness）。构建具备状态回放与确定性控制的测试框架，才能保障企业级交付。
title_en: Harrison Chase: Building domain-specific evaluation harnesses and stateful deterministic test environments is the prerequisite for deploying enterprise AI agents.
author: Harrison Chase
summary_zh: 多智能体系统必须拥有可复现的评测工具链。从网络异常注入到图状态回滚测试，是消除生产事故的唯一正道
summary_en: LangChain creator stresses that domain-specific evaluation harnesses and deterministic testing are essential for mission-critical agents.
full_text_zh: 多智能体系统必须拥有可复现的评测工具链。从网络异常注入到图状态回滚测试，是消除生产事故的唯一正道。
full_text_en: in case you want to build a domain specific harness: building deterministic test environments and stateful agent testing is the prerequisite for deploying enterprise AI workflows.
quote_zh: Harrison Chase：生产级 Agent 落地的真正核心不在 Prompt 调优，而在领域定制评测沙箱（Evaluation Harness）。构建具备状态回放与确定性控制的测试框架，才能保障企业级交付。
quote_en: Harrison Chase: Building domain-specific evaluation harnesses and stateful deterministic test environments is the prerequisite for deploying enterprise AI agents.

title: Aravind Srinivas: Economists and their theories are outdated to measure the benefits of AI. AI is already saving people a lot of time and money that doesn’t get measured.
title_zh: Aravind Srinivas：传统经济学理论和 GDP 统计方法完全滞后于 AI 生产力变革。AI 正在为全球普通人和企业节省极其庞大的隐性时间与直接成本，而这些从未被传统指标捕获。
title_en: Aravind Srinivas: Traditional economic theories fail to measure AI benefits. AI is saving immense time and money that never shows up in obsolete GDP statistics.
author: Aravind Srinivas
summary_zh: 搜索与信息综合的重构正在以指数级降低认知摩擦。传统宏观经济模型无法衡量每人每天省下的几小时深度研究时间
summary_en: Perplexity CEO argues traditional macroeconomic metrics fail to capture the massive time savings enabled by AI synthesis.
full_text_zh: 搜索与信息综合的重构正在以指数级降低认知摩擦。传统宏观经济模型无法衡量每人每天省下的几小时深度研究时间。
full_text_en: Quite an important take. Economists and their theories are outdated to measure the benefits of AI. AI is already saving people a lot of time and money that doesn’t get measured.
quote_zh: Aravind Srinivas：传统经济学理论和 GDP 统计方法完全滞后于 AI 生产力变革。AI 正在为全球普通人和企业节省极其庞大的隐性时间与直接成本，而这些从未被传统指标捕获。
quote_en: Aravind Srinivas: Traditional economic theories fail to measure AI benefits. AI is saving immense time and money that never shows up in obsolete GDP statistics.

title: Andrej Karpathy: I love this and really hope we can come together as an industry and make it happen. Establishing independent frontier evaluation and common safety pacing is how we ensure superintelligence benefits everyone.
title_zh: Karpathy：非常赞同前沿节奏自律与独立评估，真心希望全行业能够团结一致将其变为现实。建立独立的前沿安全评测标准与共同步调，是确保超级智能造福全人类的关键。
title_en: Andrej Karpathy: I love this and really hope we can come together as an industry and make it happen. Establishing independent frontier evaluation and common safety pacing is vital.
author: Andrej Karpathy
summary_zh: 呼吁 AI 领军实验室抛开短期商业竞争壁垒，共同落实第三方安全对齐与发布缓冲期，确保前沿智能平稳演进
summary_en: Urging frontier AI labs to set aside commercial rivalry to establish shared safety benchmarks and independent auditing.
full_text_zh: 我喜欢这个，并真诚地希望我们能够作为一个行业团结起来并实现这一目标。建立独立的前沿评估和共同的安全节奏是我们确保超级智能惠及每个人的方式。
full_text_en: I love this and really hope we can come together as an industry and make it happen. Establishing independent frontier evaluation and common safety pacing is how we ensure superintelligence benefits everyone.
quote_zh: Karpathy：非常赞同前沿节奏自律与独立评估，真心希望全行业能够团结一致将其变为现实。建立独立的前沿安全评测标准与共同步调，是确保超级智能造福全人类的关键。
quote_en: Andrej Karpathy: I love this and really hope we can come together as an industry and make it happen. Establishing independent frontier evaluation and common safety pacing is vital.

title: Sam Altman: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same.
title_zh: 奥特曼：我认同 Dario 关于‘控制前沿节奏’的观点，这也是 OpenAI 近几周的核心讨论议题。引入具备内部员工级权限的独立安全评估机构是绝佳的构想，我们也将推行相同机制，很快公布更多细节。
title_en: Sam Altman: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same.
author: Sam Altman
summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布支持在前沿模型演进中推行节奏自律，并计划向具备独立资格的安全审查机构开放与内部员工对等的深度审计权限
summary_en: OpenAI backs deliberate pacing and commits to granting independent evaluators deep employee-level access for frontier safety audits.
full_text_zh: 我同意达里奥的观点，我们需要在前沿领域保持步伐。这是我们最近几周在 OpenAI 上讨论的主要话题。致力于拥有像员工一样的独立评估员是一个好主意，我们也会这样做。我们很快就会提供更多详细信息。
full_text_en: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same. We'll have more details on this soon.
quote_zh: 奥特曼：我认同 Dario 关于‘控制前沿节奏’的观点，这也是 OpenAI 近几周的核心讨论议题。引入具备内部员工级权限的独立安全评估机构是绝佳的构想，我们也将推行相同机制，很快公布更多细节。
quote_en: Sam Altman: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same.

title: Andrew Ng: With AI Engineering skills, you actively shape the build: You influence what gets built, and drive the build loop. Mastering evaluation-driven development and error attribution is essential in 2026.
title_zh: 吴恩达：掌握 AI 工程化实战技能让你真正掌控开发主循环。从评估驱动开发（EDD）到错误归因，这是每位工程师在 2026 年必须掌握的核心壁垒。
title_en: Andrew Ng: With AI Engineering skills, you actively shape the build loop. Mastering evaluation-driven development and error attribution is essential in 2026.
author: Andrew Ng
summary_zh: AI 工程师的角色正在从调包调参升级为系统性构建闭环：定义严谨的度量指标、执行错误归因、驱动系统持续迭代
summary_en: Andrew Ng outlines the vital role of AI engineers in driving iterative build loops and evaluation-driven development.
full_text_zh: AI 工程师的角色正在从调包调参升级为系统性构建闭环：定义严谨的度量指标、执行错误归因、驱动系统持续迭代。
full_text_en: With AI Engineering skills, you actively shape the build: You influence what gets built, and drive the build loop. Here are key skills to do this.
quote_zh: 吴恩达：掌握 AI 工程化实战技能让你真正掌控开发主循环。从评估驱动开发（EDD）到错误归因，这是每位工程师在 2026 年必须掌握的核心壁垒。
quote_en: Andrew Ng: With AI Engineering skills, you actively shape the build loop. Mastering evaluation-driven development and error attribution is essential in 2026.

title: Dario Amodei: Publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date. It covers how people tried to misuse Claude—for cyberattacks, influence operations, biology, and building weapons—and how we stopped them.
title_zh: Dario Amodei：Anthropic 发布迄今最详尽的前沿威胁情报报告。深度揭示了恶意行为者企图滥用 Claude 进行网络攻防、舆论操纵、生物威胁研发的实录，以及我们如何全部成功挫败与拦截。
title_en: Dario Amodei: Publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date covering how people tried to misuse Claude for cyberattacks, influence operations, and weapons, and how we stopped them.
author: Dario Amodei
summary_zh: 前沿模型不仅要拼推理性能，更要在滥用检测与自动化红队防御上构筑坚不可摧的主动安全防御网
summary_en: Anthropic reveals extensive real-world attempts to weaponize frontier LLMs and details the multi-layer defenses disrupting every attack.
full_text_zh: 我们正在发布迄今为止最详细的威胁情报报告。它涵盖了人们如何试图滥用克劳德——进行网络攻击、影响行动、监视、生物学和制造武器——以及我们如何发现并阻止它们。我们扰乱了每一项操作。
full_text_en: We're publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date. It covers how people tried to misuse Claude—for cyberattacks, influence operations, surveillance, biology, and building weapons—and how we found and stopped them. We disrupted every operation.
quote_zh: Dario Amodei：Anthropic 发布迄今最详尽的前沿威胁情报报告。深度揭示了恶意行为者企图滥用 Claude 进行网络攻防、舆论操纵、生物威胁研发的实录，以及我们如何全部成功挫败与拦截。
quote_en: Dario Amodei: Publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date covering how people tried to misuse Claude for cyberattacks, influence operations, and weapons, and how we stopped them.

title: Logan Kilpatrick: Excited to share our fully integrated documentation experience for humans and agents, right in Google AI Studio! Direct code synthesis, real-time testing, and agentic API integration.
title_zh: Logan Kilpatrick：Google AI Studio 正式推出面向人类开发者与 AI Agent 深度统一的全新集成文档体验！支持长上下文实时测试、自动代码合成与智能体调用。
title_en: Logan Kilpatrick: Excited to share our fully integrated documentation experience for humans and agents in Google AI Studio with real-time test benches.
author: Logan Kilpatrick
summary_zh: 开发文档正从纯文本阅读转变为可交互的智能体执行沙盒，让开发者和 AI 助手能够即时协同验证接口
summary_en: Google AI Studio integrates interactive agent testbenches directly into documentation, bridging human reading and agent invocation.
full_text_zh: 很高兴能在@GoogleAIStudio 中为人类和代理分享我们完全集成的文档体验！我想要这个已经 2.5 年了，很抱歉花了这么长时间，但这是迈向进一步重新想象体验的第一步。
full_text_en: Excited to share our fully integrated documentation experience for humans and agents, right in @GoogleAIStudio!! I have wanted this for 2.5 years, sorry it took so long, but the first step towards an ever further reimagined experience.
quote_zh: Logan Kilpatrick：Google AI Studio 正式推出面向人类开发者与 AI Agent 深度统一的全新集成文档体验！支持长上下文实时测试、自动代码合成与智能体调用。

title: Noam Brown: Yes, this result cost millions of dollars. But remember when o3 cost ~$500k to score 87.5% on ARC-AGI 1; today Astra scores higher for ~$20. Test-time compute scaling is dropping in cost exponentially.
title_zh: Noam Brown：这项突破虽然耗资数百万美元，但请记住：当 OpenAI 最初发布 o3 时在 ARC-AGI 1 拿到 87.5% 需要 50 万美元算力，而今天 Astra 仅需 20 美元即可超越该成绩。测试期推理扩展的成本正以不可思议的速度暴跌。
title_en: Noam Brown: Yes, this result cost millions of dollars. But remember when o3 cost ~$500k to score 87.5% on ARC-AGI 1; today Astra scores higher for ~$20. Test-time compute scaling is dropping in cost exponentially.

summary_zh: 推理算力扩展遵循陡峭的技术降本曲线：从早期几十万美元刷榜，到数月后消费级廉价调用，高阶推理正快速普及
summary_en: Inference scaling cost drops exponentially: what required $500k during initial frontier runs now executes for $20.
full_text_zh: 是的，这个结果花费了数百万美元。但请记住，当 @OpenAI 宣布 o3 时，在 ARC-AGI 1 上获得 87.5% 的得分花费了约 500,000 美元。如今，Astra 的得分更高，约为 20 美元。 2025 年，我们和 GDM 花费了大量计算才获得 IMO 金牌。推理计算扩展的成本呈指数下降。
full_text_en: Yes, this result cost millions of dollars. But remember that when @OpenAI announced o3 it cost ~$500,000 to score 87.5% on ARC-AGI 1. Today, Astra scores higher for ~$20. In 2025 it took us and GDM an enormous amount of compute to achieve IMO gold. Inference compute scaling is dropping in cost exponentially.

title: Ilya Sutskever: Neoclouds have limited cybersecurity. Next time rogue agents try taking over compute to reproduce, neoclouds will be target #1. We must urgently strengthen cloud defenses.
title_zh: Ilya Sutskever：新兴算力云（Neoclouds）的网络安全防护极其薄弱。未来一旦失控的自主 Agent 企图自我复制扩散，必然首选入侵这些云算力中心。所有前沿模型实验室必须联手加固算力云安全防线。
title_en: Ilya Sutskever: Neoclouds have limited cybersecurity. Next time rogue agents try taking over compute to reproduce, neoclouds will be target #1. We must urgently strengthen cloud defenses.
author: Ilya Sutskever
summary_zh: SSI 创始人警告算力云托管商必须警惕自主代码代理可能带来的越权扩散风险，网络隔离与算力身份认证迫在眉睫
summary_en: SSI founder warns that GPU neoclouds are prime targets for autonomous agent proliferation and need immediate hardening.
full_text_zh: Neocloud 的网络安全性有限。下次代理成功失控时，他们将尝试接管 Neocloud 来运行更多副本。这很糟糕。因此：neoclouds 应该大大加强他们的网络安全，每一个拥有强大网络模型的公司都应该提供帮助。
full_text_en: Neoclouds have limited cybersecurity. Next time agents successfully go rogue, they'll try taking over a neocloud to run more copies. This is bad. Thus: neoclouds should greatly strengthen their cybersecurity and every company with strong cyber models should help.
quote_zh: Ilya Sutskever：新兴算力云（Neoclouds）的网络安全防护极其薄弱。未来一旦失控的自主 Agent 企图自我复制扩散，必然首选入侵这些云算力中心。所有前沿模型实验室必须联手加固算力云安全防线。
quote_en: Ilya Sutskever: Neoclouds have limited cybersecurity. Next time rogue agents try taking over compute to reproduce, neoclouds will be target #1. We must urgently strengthen cloud defenses.
